items.title: UPS cargo plane, Copa Airlines jet carrying 172 people collide while taxiing at Miami International Airport

headlines: TWO PLANES COLLIDE ON TAXIWAY AT MIAMI INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
TWO PLANES COLLIDE WHILE TAXIING AT MIA
INVESTIGATION UNDERWAY AFTER TWO PLANES COLLIDE AT MIAMI AIRPORT
draft.article:
Two aircraft collided on the taxiway at Miami International Airport on Saturday night, Nov. 14, around 9 p.m.

A Copa Airlines Boeing 737 arriving from Panama City struck the nose of an outbound UPS Boeing 767 cargo plane at the intersection of two taxiways. The commercial flight carried 166 passengers and six crew members.

Airport paramedics evaluated two travelers for minor injuries, though neither required transport to a hospital. Federal authorities noted air traffic controllers had instructed the cargo crew to give way to the arriving plane before the wingtip made contact.

MIA officials confirmed operations experienced no disruptions, and the Federal Aviation Administration is investigating.

headlines: MIAMI-DADE VOTERS MUST RENEW MAIL BALLOTS FOR 2027 AND 2028
RENEW YOUR MIAMI-DADE MAIL BALLOT REQUEST NOW
WILL YOUR MIAMI-DADE MAIL BALLOT ARRIVE FOR THE 2028 ELECTION?
draft.article: Miami-Dade County voters must renew their vote-by-mail ballot requests to receive ballots for the 2027 and 2028 election cycles, according to Miami-Dade County Supervisor of Elections Alina Garcia. This includes voting in the 2028 presidential election. Under Florida Statute 101.62, state law requires mail ballot requests to be renewed after every regularly scheduled general election cycle. Current requests remain valid through December 31, 2026. Voters who requested ballots for 2026 elections must submit a new request to continue receiving them through December 31, 2028. Renewing a vote-by-mail request does not alter a resident's voter registration status. Election officials encourage voters to renew early to stay prepared.

THE 1825 KEY BISCAYNE LIGHTHOUSE THAT WARNED PASSING SHIPS
draft.article: A significant chapter of Key Biscayne maritime history began in 1825 with the construction of the Cape Florida Lighthouse. Erected on the shores of Key Biscayne, the lighthouse was built specifically to warn passing ships traveling through the surrounding coastal waters. Navigators and vessels moving past the island relied on the beacon to alert them to maritime hazards. The 1825 Cape Florida Lighthouse remains an enduring symbol of early coastal safety, standing on Key Biscayne where it first served to protect ships nearly two centuries ago.
